context: This criteria evaluates correct usage of the library's statistical functions. It checks that dedicated statistical functions (mean, median, std, variance, min, max, sum, quantileSeq) are used rather than manual implementations, and that the results are returned as plain numbers.

checklist.name: Uses library statistical functions
checklist.description: describeDataset uses the library's mean(), median(), std(), variance(), min(), max(), and sum() functions rather than implementing these calculations manually.

checklist.name: Uses quantileSeq() for quantile
checklist.description: The quantile() function uses the library's quantileSeq() function to compute the specified quantile, not a manual sorting/interpolation approach.

checklist.name: Returns plain numbers
checklist.description: All properties in the returned object are plain JavaScript numbers, not library-specific BigNumber or other typed values.

checklist.name: Correct statistical values
checklist.description: All statistical values (mean, median, std, variance, min, max, sum) are correctly computed for the given test datasets.

checklist.name: Returns all required properties
checklist.description: The describeDataset return object contains all seven required properties: mean, median, std, min, max, sum, and variance.
